document: UC7.1 LIBERO-10 evaluation and factual review notes
scope: Read-only source and saved-result review; no tests or model/simulator requests run

claims.text: Report official success, terminal strict physical success, diagnostic release/settle success and v2_success as separate quantities.
claims.avoid: Do not use video SUCCESS or runner exit code 0 as proof of strict physical completion.

claims.text: Let R be raw official success at episode end, T strict terminal conjunction, H the per-atom hold-only exception, S strict after diagnostic release/settle, and Rs raw after settle. v2_success = R AND [T OR (H AND S AND Rs)].

For every failing terminal atom, all failed checks must belong to HELD_CHECKS and that same atom must fail not_held or robot_not_touching_part. HELD_CHECKS = not_held, robot_not_touching_part, at_rest, joint_at_rest, orientation_kept. Support and containment failures are outside the set.
claims.avoid: Do not defer an unheld moving object merely because another object is held.

claims.text: Task 1 has raw=true, strict terminal=false, strict after diagnostic=true and v2=false. Butter fails not_held, at_rest, supported_by_container_or_contents, lowest_point_below_rim, not_perched_on_rim; cream cheese fails at_rest alone. Both objects therefore independently prevent the per-atom hold-only exception.
claims.avoid: Do not re-score this run as v2_success=true after diagnostic settling.

claims.text: Task 0 has raw=true and both terminal and after-diagnostic strict=false. Alphabet soup passes. Tomato sauce lacks admissible container/contents support at the stop and after diagnostic settling; after settling the not_held and at_rest checks pass but supported_by_container_or_contents and not_perched_on_rim remain false.
claims.avoid: The failed check named not_perched_on_rim is not by itself proof that the object is literally perched on the top rim; it detects absence of admissible below-rim support.

claims.text: Strict inside checks cover no robot holding, rest, admissible container/contents support, no outside support, lowest collision point at least 10 mm below rim, support at least 5 mm below rim, below-rim footprint within walls with 5 mm tolerance, and COM over cavity. Inside does not require orientation_kept under D1.
claims.avoid: A tilted object inside the basket can pass strict inside if the required support/containment/rest checks pass.

claims.text: With sufficient history, object rest uses maximum displacement below 1 mm and rotation below 1 degree relative to current pose over the recent window (10 steps here); it replaces the instantaneous-velocity rest Boolean. Without enough history, fallback thresholds are 0.01 m/s and 0.10 rad/s.
claims.avoid: A recorded instantaneous speed above 0.01 m/s does not necessarily contradict at_rest=true when rest_source is window_10_steps.

claims.text: The 38-action counterfactual runs only after terminal artifacts are captured: open 10, lift 8 with action_z=0.5, settle 20. It is evaluator diagnosis, excluded from scored policy actions and completion time.
claims.avoid: Do not append these 38 actions to reported task actions or present their final state as the scored endpoint.

claims.text: Executive requests receive synchronized RGB, measured robot state, camera/robot geometry and history. Initial plan/replan prompt explicitly says no calibration and requests external-view direction words; prepare computes/fixes camera direction data for review and later execution.
claims.avoid: Do not call the whole framework uncalibrated RGB-only, and do not imply the initial planner receives the executive geometry payload.

claims.text: The model owns execution. Generic measured fragments or direct motion can complete whole subtasks without a native holding certificate or native scene registration/motion calibration. Native hold/turn/place_on/release macros are optional accelerators, leased for 1-60 control actions; their setup consumes that budget.
claims.avoid: Do not portray v7.1 as a mandatory native skill chain or treat unavailable native geometry as a universal movement prohibition.

claims.text: The local controller recomputes target error and returns on arrival/events/checkpoints/budget. It does not certify semantic attachment, placement or success and does not discover obstacles or plan a collision-free whole-arm path.
claims.avoid: Measured pose arrival, stable finger gap, motion envelopes and initially collision-free layouts do not establish full collision safety.

claims.text: external_view_v1 is a global horizontal convention: projected external-camera +X is viewer-right and up cross right is away. This is not a local perspective Jacobian. Large roll/local plane/inverted-view policy is deferred; inverted views retain the formula and are diagnosed rather than vetoed. A nearly vertical camera X projection (norm < 1e-9) makes the frame unavailable.
claims.avoid: Do not claim arbitrary perspective/roll/inversion invariance or that wrist rotation was changed.

claims.text: Both Oct30 reviewed plans contain regions=[]. The two basket episodes exercise the UC7.1 pipeline and carry the direction contract, but cannot alone establish correctness of directional-region execution.
claims.avoid: Do not cite t0/t1 as a new right_of/front_of validation or as a full LIBERO-10 sweep.

claims.text: Oct28 release V0 comparison reports baseline 279 passed / 59 failed; UC7.1 350 passed / 59 failed; all 71 added tests passed; 0 added failures and 0 lost old tests. The 59 failures were pre-existing.
claims.avoid: Do not claim the repository test suite is fully green.

claims.text: Oct28 V1 is a planning-only set of 13 scenes: 10 LIBERO-10 + g5 + t6 relayout + RoboCasa coffee. All 13 drafts generated, 38/38 direction/part-pointing checks passed, original draft legality 12/13 due t9 do=turn,sense=close. There were no execution calls, policy actions, approvals or API-key calls in V1.
claims.avoid: V1 overall had not passed; the corrected t9 suggestion must not replace original draft validity.

claims.text: Task IDs are zero-based 0-9. The registry table is supported task scope and official prompt mapping, not evidence of ten completed current-version runs.

Eligible official completion time is control_elapsed_s - video_render_s. It includes execution-model waiting, local computation, simulator actions and control logging; excludes initial planning, approval, reset/startup, postepisode diagnostic and cleanup. Video duration omits inference waiting and is not completion time.
claims.avoid: Do not infer a speedup ratio from different t0/t1 tasks, incomparable layouts or incomplete baselines.

claims.text: Task 0: 10 execution requests accepted + 1 prior planning request used = 11 unique task requests. Task 1: 12 execution requests accepted + 1 prior planning request used = 13. Each execution reused its saved draft, adding zero new planning calls at launch. Both use Astra high/subscription with zero API-key calls.
claims.avoid: Do not count reused drafts as free overall, or count them twice in actual campaign sends.

claims.text: No automatic full episode retry. Same-request retries remain limited: overload category up to two retries; transient stream/network category up to two total retries. Categories have independent counters, so mixed errors do not imply a three-send ceiling. HTTP520/unknown_error and deadline exceeded are not retryable under this policy.
claims.avoid: Do not say all automatic retries are disabled or that every request has at most 3 sends.

claims.text: Collision contacts are recorded independently and do not stop these episodes. Report aggregate counts as flagged contact-point samples across physics checks, not distinct impacts or unique collisions.
claims.avoid: Do not imply successful collision avoidance or treat contact counts as collision events.

put both the cream cheese box and the butter in the basket
turn on the stove and put the moka pot on it
put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it

pick up the book and place it in the back compartment of the caddy

suggested_short_result_sentence: Both approved rearranged episodes reached official LIBERO success. Neither passed v2 strict physical success at the scored endpoint. Task 1 passed the separate release-and-settle diagnostic; Task 0 still failed admissible-support checks.
review_checklist: Task catalog must not imply complete sweep.
Use current v7.1 naming and protocol; v7 PDF is historical.
Only native macros need native scene registration/calibration; camera geometry is permitted for executive.
Keep mathematical direction convention plus limits together.
Measured controller envelopes are not obstacle-planning guarantees.
No t0/t1 speedup ratio; no speedup evidence inferred from product name.
38 diagnostic actions are not policy actions.
Place source paths and run identifiers in PDF provenance.
